description: SGT Pipe models field pipeline hydraulics and links gathering or injection networks to well and pump models. The provider describes bottleneck analysis, diameter selection and energy-use optimisation. The provider is SibGeoTech. Coverage: The application is generic to oil and gas field infrastructure. Network size, geographic extent and operating periods depend on supplied inputs. Access: The provider describes the software and its associated SGT Well and SGT Pump products. No software was obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a price or full licence conditions. Provider confirmation is required. Limitations: The stated functions were read in Russian product documentation. Solver methods, accuracy and required companion licences were not tested. For simulation it supports joint analysis of surface pipes, wells and pumping arrangements. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling.
